groups.name: usb_in
groups.why: USB-C receptacle (north edge, declared) with its CC1/CC2 5.1k pull-downs, the USBLC6 ESD array right behind the D+/D- pins, and the VBUS Schottky D2 into the 5 V rail Net-(D2-K)

groups.name: power
groups.why: power entry and the 3V3 buck: LM73100 ideal-diode/eFuse from the Teensy-pin /VIN with its UVLO/OVLO divider R11/R12/R13, ORed with VBUS into Net-(D2-K); TPS62162 buck U7 with inductor L2, its input caps C1/C26 on Net-(D2-K) and the 22 uF output cap C27 on +3V3

groups.name: mcu
groups.why: RP2354A with its core-regulator inductor L1 and the /RP2354A/1V1 caps (DVDD x3 + VREG_FB), the VREG_AVDD RC (R3 33R + C5), ten 3V3 caps for its ten 3V3 supply pins (IOVDD x6, QSPI_IOVDD, USB_OTP_VDD, ADC_AVDD, VREG_VIN), and the USB 27R series pair R4/R5, which on an RP2040/RP2350 sits at the chip; the 12 MHz crystal Y1 and its load caps are claimed at XIN/XOUT by place_simple

groups.name: psram
groups.why: APS1604M QSPI PSRAM on the back face with its (DNP) back-face decap C2; its six QSPI nets are on U6's north pin row

groups.name: debug
groups.why: back-face Tag-Connect SWD pads (SWCLK/SWDIO/RUN on U6's south row) and the back-face Qwiic JST-SH I2C connector (SDA/SCL on U6's east row): both talk only to the RP2354A

groups.name: fpga
groups.why: Efinix T8F49 WLCSP FPGA with its +1V1 core caps (VCC x2 + PLL) and four 3V3 caps for its four VCCIO balls, the TPS7A20 1V1 LDO U4 whose output feeds only the FPGA (point-of-load), the 32 MHz oscillator Y2 on PLLIN with its enable pull-down R6, and the two 10k arrays: RN2 the configuration pull-ups/downs (DONE, CS, RESET, PIN.11) and RN1 pull-ups on four FPGA pins

groups.name: ui
groups.why: RGB LED D1 with its three series resistors R7/R8/R9 (driven by FPGA R/G/B) and the side-actuated button SW1 on the FPGA's CSO pin
